Lending glossary!B2: A contractual duty requiring the borrower to repay outstanding principal by the specified due date.
Lending glossary!B4: A sequence of dates and amounts specifying when the borrower must repay the outstanding loan balance.
Lending glossary!B3: A contractual arrangement in which a lender advances funds to a borrower subject to repayment conditions.
Lending glossary!B5: The date on which funds are transferred between the borrower and lender to settle a repayment obligation.
Lending glossary!B6: The amount of outstanding principal that a lender could lose if a borrower fails to repay.
